args.message:
Upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4

Fixes CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing
deeply nested arrays. Affects fastjson <2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Reason
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting versions <2.9.4. Version 2.9.4 fixes this vulnerability.

## CI
CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix-fastjson-cve-2026-31337` (commit `c8b8ab7878`) passed.
